    forced_words = case['forced_words']

    candidates = [i for i in range(len(word_token_indices)) if i not in selected_set]
    # sort candidates by score descending, then index ascending
    candidates.sort(key=lambda i: (-word_scores[i], i))
    for i in candidates:
        tok_count = len(word_token_indices[i])

            remaining_budget -= tok_count

        retained_token_indices.extend(word_token_indices[wi])
    tokens_used = len(retained_token_indices)
    return {
        "retained_token_indices": retained_token_indices,
        "selected_words": selected_words,
        "tokens_used": tokens_used
    }
